title: Add CourseReview skill variant for interactive study sessions
description:
Adds a study-oriented skill variant to process. Exploratory-first, vault changes optional.

## Design

- Invocation: csnotes process --course CPSC5002 (no new flag; CourseReview auto-selected when scope is Course)
- Two output layers:
  1. Journal accompaniment: always emitted as CreateNote to _journal/{course}/review-{date}.md — captures ephemeral context (lab confusion, instructor framing) that belongs in study narrative but not long-term reference vault
  2. Optional atomic ops: CreateNote/UpdateNote to _synthetic/ only when something reference-worthy surfaces; zero atomic ops is valid
- Session header embeds expected journal path so the AI knows where to write it

## Implementation
- SkillVariant::CourseReview added to config.rs
- journal_dir config key (default _journal) in VaultConfig
- instruction_source_path() returns course-review.md for CourseReview
- process.rs auto-selects CourseReview when args.course is Some
- render_session_md Course arm embeds journal path
- New _csnotes/instructions/course-review.md

## Depends on L52 (done)
